zigiBackend.title: Senior Backend Developer — Zigi App (Banco Industrial)
zigiBackend.description: I design and implement financial microservices with NestJS and TypeScript, applying Hexagonal Architecture, Domain-Driven Design and CQRS. I build event-driven architectures with AWS EventBridge, SQS and SNS, manage cloud-native infrastructure on AWS EKS (Kubernetes), and secure endpoints via AWS WAF, API Gateway and Lambda Authorizers. I author technical documentation (HLD, ADR) and cross-cutting libraries to accelerate Time-to-Market.

zigiFrontend.title: Senior Frontend Developer — Zigi App (Banco Industrial)
zigiFrontend.description: I led the technical development and UI architecture of a market-leading financial application using React Native and MobX. I designed security protocols within core flows that cut fraud-driven operational losses by 15%, and integrated SDKs such as MoEngage for personalized communications, lifting user retention by up to 30%. I took part in architecture committees and mentored the development team.

ciancoders.title: Full Stack Developer — Ciancoder (GT) / Enapsys (MX)
ciancoders.description: I led the modernization of the Procure-to-Pay process for corporate clients. I developed and deployed robust APIs with NestJS and GraphQL, cutting response latency for critical business processes, and implemented efficient storage architectures with SQL and Redis for high-volume data. I established quality standards through code reviews and technical mentorship for junior developers.

freelance.title: Full Stack Developer — Freelance
freelance.description: I manage the full software development life cycle for international clients using Next.js, Python/Django and Flutter. I automate deployments through CI/CD pipelines on AWS and Digital Ocean, and consult on secure infrastructure and resilient architectures to solve complex business challenges.
